description: Describe what you need ("web search", "weather forecast", "verify an email", "pdf to text", "people enrichment") and get the top 1-5 pay-per-call (x402) APIs to use, from an hourly index of Coinbase's x402 marketplace (~38,000 endpoints). Ranked by evidence that other agents keep paying for them: calls per paying wallet over 30 days (so one-off sampling bots count little), how recently each was paid, relevance and price vs. typical. Top candidates are checked live (still asking for payment, at the listed price). Each result: endpoint URL, method, price, network, why it ranks there, and flags (mostly one-time payers, above typical price, not called recently, did not answer). Read-only; never pays.

check_live.description: Check the top candidates live (default true). False is faster.

max_price_usd.description: Optional price cap per call in USD, e.g. 0.05.

task.description: What you need the API for, in a few words, e.g. "web search", "transcribe audio", "company enrichment".

name: find_best_api
title: Which paid API should I call?
